user.title: Connect to Blocky
user.description: Enter the base URL of the Blocky HTTP API.

settings.title: Blocky settings
settings.description: Authentication, polling, and endpoint paths are optional. Paths are relative to the base URL and may include a reverse-proxy prefix.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Blocky
reconfigure.description: Update the connection, authentication, polling, or endpoint settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Blocky
reauth_confirm.description: The Blocky proxy rejected the configured credentials. Enter replacement HTTP Basic Auth credentials.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.invalid_auth: The Blocky proxy rejected the credentials.
error.auth_pair: Enter both a username and a password.
error.invalid_status_path: The blocking status path returned an HTTP error.
error.invalid_status_response: The blocking status response is invalid.
error.invalid_stats_path: The statistics path returned an HTTP error.
error.invalid_endpoint: Enter valid endpoint paths without queries or fragments.

abort.already_configured: This Blocky instance is already configured.

disable_for_duration.name: Disable blocking for a duration
disable_for_duration.description: Temporarily disable Blocky blocking for a duration and optional groups.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Blocky Go duration such as 30m, 1h, or 5m30s.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: Optional comma-separated Blocky groups. Empty means all groups.
